To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the complexation of the antimycotic drug sertaconazole with cyclodextrins significantly enhances its solubility in aqueous solution, and its antimycotic activity against Candida albicans.
sertaconazole solubility and activity against Candida albicans are significantly improved by the complexation of the drug with different cyclodextins.

the solubility enhancement effect and the antimycotic activity enhancement effect of sertaconazole complexed with gamma-CD are the strongest, and the solubility-enhancement effect and the antimyotic activity-enhancement effect of sertaconazle complexed with hydroxypropyl gamma-CD are second strongest.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the preparation, characterization, and evaluation of the solubility- and antimycotic-activity-enhancing properties of cyclodextrin complexes of sertaconazole.
the preparation and characterization of solid-state complexes and the study of the effects of the cyclodextrin complexation on the solubilizing and antimycotic properties of sertaconazole.
the preparation and evaluation of sertaconazole complexes with cyclodextrin derivatives, with the aim of increasing the aqueous solublity and antimycotic effect of the drug.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the complexation of cyclodextrin with sertaconazole enhances the solubility, the antimycotic activity and the drug stability.
sertaconazole-gamma-CD complex is a promising candidate as a drug carrier system, for the improvement of its solubilizing properties and for the enhancement of the antimycotic activity.
sertaconazole-gamma-CD complex is the most promising for the development of an improved formulation for sertaconazole.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the complexation of the drug with gamma-CD and HP-gamma-CD, in particular, can be used to enhance both its solubility in aqueous media and its antimycotic activity, and thus may have important applications in pharmaceutical formulations of sertaconazole.
the complexation of cyclodextrin with sertaconazole nitrite can significantly increase its solubility in aqueous solutions.
gamma-CD is the most suitable CD derivative for the complexation of the antimycotic sertaconazole.
The main takeaway from our work is that
gamma-CD is the best CD derivative to increase the aqueous soluibility and antimycotic effect of sertaconazole.
the use of cyclodextrin derivatives is a useful strategy to improve the solubility, dissolution and antimycotic efficacy of sertaconazole.

the complexation of the antimycotic drug sertaconazole with cyclodextrins is an efficient strategy for improving its solubility in aqueous media and its antimycotic activity, which could be useful for improving the bioavailability of sertaconazole and the effectiveness of its antimycotic therapy.
